parts.title: 1 · Choose the recordings
parts.body: An operator on our team picks what to run, for example all of SoundHub project 123.

parts.title: 2 · Resolve the list
parts.body: The soundhub-robin catalog adapter asks the SoundHub API for the project's recordings, using the operator's own SoundHub token. ROBIN never stores it.

parts.title: 3 · Record the run
parts.body: robin runs submit freezes the list and records the run, the list and the claims in PostgreSQL, so nothing already done is run twice.

parts.title: 4 · Launch the jobs
parts.body: The controller (robin reconcile --loop) starts one SageMaker worker job per task. Jobs read SoundHub's audio from S3 with their own role.

parts.title: 5 · Write the outputs
parts.body: Each worker writes its result.json and Parquet outputs to Amazon S3.

parts.title: 6 · Record the outcomes
parts.body: The controller checks each result file and records the outcomes in the database.

parts.title: 7 · Show the detections
parts.body: api-dock reads ROBIN's published views to find the right Parquet file, and SoundHub's web app shows the detections by recording ID. SoundHub's code is unchanged.
